findings.claim: The new feature-flags feature folder only contains a store subdirectory with its own index.ts, but lacks a feature-root index.ts exporting its public hooks, selectors, actions and types. Without it, any future consumer of selectFeatureFlagOverrides, selectOverrideCount or setOverride would have to deep-import from the store path instead of the feature's public API, which is the pattern the feature-boundary convention and public-API rule are meant to prevent.
